subject: Life Sciences
topic: Hominid fossils and South African discoveries

items.q: A foramen magnum positioned forward, under the skull, indicates that a hominid:
items.qAf: ’n Foramen magnum wat vorentoe, onder die skedel, geleë is, dui aan dat ’n hominied:
optionsAf: regop op twee bene geloop het
items.explain: The spinal cord enters from below when the body is upright — bipedalism.
items.explainAf: Die rugmurg gaan van onder in die skedel in wanneer die liggaam regop is — tweevoetigheid.

items.q: Compared with Australopithecus, Homo sapiens has:
items.qAf: In vergelyking met Australopithecus het Homo sapiens:
options: a larger cranium and smaller brow ridges
a smaller cranium and larger brow ridges
items.explain: Trends: larger brain, flatter face, reduced brow ridges and jaws.
items.explainAf: Tendense: groter brein, platter gesig, kleiner wenkbrouriwwe en kakebene.

items.q: A hominid’s brain volume increased from 450 cm³ to 1 350 cm³. The percentage increase is:
items.qAf: ’n Hominied se breinvolume het van 450 cm³ tot 1 350 cm³ toegeneem. Die persentasietoename is:

items.q: The Taung Child, found in South Africa, is a fossil of:
items.qAf: Die Taung-kind, wat in Suid-Afrika gevind is, is ’n fossiel van:
items.explain: The Taung Child (1924) was the first Australopithecus africanus fossil described.
items.explainAf: Die Taung-kind (1924) was die eerste Australopithecus africanus-fossiel wat beskryf is.

items.q: Engraved ochre and shell beads at Blombos Cave are evidence of:
items.qAf: Gegraveerde oker en skulpkrale by Blomboskrot is bewys van:
options: symbolic thinking in early modern humans
optionsAf: simboliese denke by vroeë moderne mense
items.explain: Decorated objects show abstract, symbolic behaviour.
items.explainAf: Versierde voorwerpe wys abstrakte, simboliese gedrag.

items.q: Burnt bone and ash deep inside Wonderwerk Cave provide some of the oldest evidence of:
items.qAf: Verbrande been en as diep binne Wonderwerkgrot lewer van die oudste bewyse van:
items.explain: Wonderwerk shows controlled fire about a million years ago.
items.explainAf: Wonderwerk wys beheerde vuur ongeveer ’n miljoen jaar gelede.
